regulations.name: Restore Online Shoppers' Confidence Act
requirements: Clear disclosure of material terms BEFORE obtaining billing info

regulations.name: FTC Act Section 5
regulations.violation_type: Unfair or Deceptive Acts or Practices

forced_continuity.remediation_guidance: Disclose recurring charges and auto-renewal terms clearly before collecting billing information. Obtain express informed consent before charging. Provide a simple, conspicuous cancellation mechanism. Avoid burying material terms in fine print or post-commitment screens.

false_urgency.remediation_guidance: Remove or substantiate time-limited claims. Do not use countdown timers or 'limited availability' language unless the offer or inventory is genuinely limited. Ensure any urgency is based on real deadlines or scarcity.

fear_based_threat.remediation_guidance: Do not imply account suspension, security compromise, or loss of access to coerce immediate action. Replace threatening language with neutral, factual notices. Provide clear paths to verify or update information without fear-based pressure.
